scope: Exact regenerable CMake products, ROS install caches, and replay frame directories. Source, captured measurements, logs outside cache directories, receipts and MP4 are not hidden or deleted.
regeneration: Use each enclosing run/audit recorded request.json/inside.sh and immutable probe_source or version snapshot with its native build identity, writing to a new output directory. Replay frames use recorded video_states.json and the frozen executed_render_episode.py; frames.json retains independent per-frame hashes. Split-surface native cache uses its source_sha256.json and build_request.json; no upstream source is ignored here.
